reviews.title: Very big and effective
reviews.comment: This cooler is a member of group of large coolers for power hungry processors. Mine has up to 270 Watts of power requirement (I have not seen it so far, even in benchmark tests), so this cooler should be able to handle it. It does it with flair, but (there is always a “but”) it comes with the price of a big size. On my MSI motherboard it sits over memory slots and makes one M2 slot difficult to access. Not a deal breaker (install the memory first), just something to keep in mind. Works well and definitely worth it, especially considering the low cost.
reviews.author: Mirek

reviews.title: Buena compra por el precio que ofrece
reviews.comment: Excelente compra, mantiene fresco mi ryzen 5 9600x, es fácil de instalarlo que si necesitas un buen gabinete ya que es muy grande. Nota: no compres una pasta térmica ya que este enfriador de torre tiene uno en la caja, olvidé revisar a fondo ese detalle
reviews.author: Erick Chavez

reviews.title: A CPU cooler worth its weight in copper!!! Have you seen how much copper cost these days!
reviews.comment: Cooling performance seems to be what stands out the most for this CPU cooler! The seven 6 mm heat pipes takes care of the heat extremely well! And doing so without very much noise in the process. I came up with 27 DB when pushing the fans, which I feel was outstanding! The way this cooler produces air flow is also unique. The way the fins are mounted keeps the air flowing in an up and down vertical wave that keeps your CPU in a very happy place! Never went above high 60's Celsius when gaming. Overall for its price you get a very decent and game excelling CPU. And not to mention, a very easy install As you are given all the parts to make it go without issues all the way through. So if you're looking for an inexpensive air cooling PC cooler, for the price, this should definitely be on your list!
reviews.author: Skeeter

reviews.title: Ridiculously good for the price
reviews.comment: Fantastic cooler, especially for this price. Mounts easily, looks good, and keeps my 9800x3d ice cold Fits into the tiny Lian Li a3 if you’re wondering as well.
